ph_voicetecx_line: Speak into any app on your Mac, in Taiwan Mandarin or English. Your voice and text never leave your Mac.
ph_voicetecx_p1: Built for Traditional Chinese and Taiwan's way of writing
ph_voicetecx_p2: Your voice and text stay on your Mac; no account needed
vt_body: VoiceTecx turns your voice into text in any app on your Mac, in Taiwan Mandarin, English or a mix of both. Recognition runs on your Mac: your voice and text never leave it, there is no account, and recordings are not kept.
vt_f1_d: Press your shortcut, speak, and the text appears at your cursor. Tap to start and stop, or hold to talk.
vt_f2_d: Uses MediaTek Research's Breeze-ASR-25, trained on Taiwan Mandarin and Mandarin–English mixing, with OpenAI's Whisper for English.
vt_f3_d: Traditional characters, full-width punctuation in Chinese, Arabic numerals for money, dates and phone numbers, and English names spelled right.
vt_f4_d: Add names and product words once and they are heard correctly. Fix a mistake in History and VoiceTecx learns the fix.
vt_f5_d: Drop in an audio or video file and get a transcript with times, as text or subtitles (.srt).
vt_f6_d: Your voice and text stay on your Mac, with no account. Recordings are never kept, and each model is checked against a fixed fingerprint before it runs.
vt_n3: per sentence on an M5 MacBook
vt_num_note: Character accuracy = 100 − character error rate, on VoiceTecx's 30-sentence test set (25 Taiwan Mandarin, 5 English), read by one speaker, M5 MacBook, November 2026. Comparisons with other dictation apps will be added once they are measured on the same set.
vt_status: In development · Mac with Apple silicon
vt_n3_cmp: Engine time, from recording to text
